definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 has no entry and the term rests on the RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1, 'the reports that may be written to a report file'). Both mean an RD-described output written to a report file, so the rule's reach (the report group a level 1 entry forms) is the same in 2002 and the reader's 2002 witnesses stand.
